description: This file contains functions for handling file and image attachments in the Notesnook web application, including file picking, image compression, encryption, and uploading.

classes.name: FileWithURI
classes.description: A class representing a file with a URI, used for image compression.

methods.name: insertAttachments
methods.description: Prompts user to select files and attaches them, with optional image compression.

methods.name: attachFiles
methods.description: Processes and attaches selected files, compressing images if configured.

methods.name: reuploadAttachment
methods.description: Allows re-uploading of an attachment by selecting a file and verifying its hash.

methods.name: pickFile
methods.description: Handles picking a non-image file and creating an attachment.

methods.name: pickImage
methods.description: Handles picking an image file, creating an attachment with dimensions.

methods.name: getEncryptionKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an encryption key for attachments.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Encrypts and adds a file as an attachment, with progress reporting.

methods.name: withProgress
methods.description: Wraps an async action with a progress modal and event subscription.

methods.name: getImageDimensions
methods.description: Retrieves the natural width and height of an image file.
